record.question: Who amongst the following is not the winner of Bharat Ratna?
record.explanation: Answer D: Mary Kom. Mary Kom had not received the Bharat Ratna by the June 2014 examination. Amartya Sen received it in 1999, and C. N. R. Rao and Sachin Tendulkar in 2014; the official recipient list includes those three and not Mary Kom. Historical/source note: Negative choice is anchored to the June 2014 examination; later awards must not be retroactively inserted. Reference: https://www.mha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-04/BharatRatna_15042024.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
